en: A black‑and‑white panoramic coastal town view taken from a rocky hill. In the foreground are sloping rocks and trees, then densely packed wooden and masonry houses with steep gabled roofs, some with dormers and small gardens. Beyond the town lies a calm harbor with piers, low industrial buildings, and a breakwater extending into the sea. In the distance are rocky islands and a hilly shoreline across the water. The overall style suggests a small Northern European seaside town, likely mid‑20th century. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
